The test only checks that StdIn contains `cwd`, the snapshot root, so a prompt that names only the working folder and none of the copies also passes. In the cancelled arm (line 195) the test checks the argv instead of the prompt for the root.
findings.fix: Check that StdIn contains the copy's own path (the snapshot sub-folder of the granted `src` root). In the cancelled arm too, check that StdIn does not contain the root.
